Lab

AlgoSynth

An algorithmic sequencer inspired by Autechre's Acroyear. Patterns are not drawn note by note, they are generated and then bent.

Rhythmic and melodic pattern generation with swing control, multi-track song mode, and MIDI output over Web MIDI to any connected instrument.

The idea taken from Acroyear is that the material comes from rules rather than the hand. You set a process running, listen, and work the parameters while it plays.

Interaction

  • Algorithmic pattern generation
  • Swing control
  • Multi-track song mode
  • Parameters editable while playing

Technical

  • Web MIDI API
  • Output to external hardware
  • Entirely in the browser

Open the instrument

Desktop only, minimum width 900 px. One tap on Play starts the audio.
